summary: Master HITL QA to ensure AI dataset accuracy and reliability. Join our 5-day intermediate course for QA reviewers and HITL specialists.
lede: Human-in-the-loop quality assurance uses human review to check and improve AI data and outputs. For professionals moving from annotation into QA, dataset governance, or HITL operations, the course covers finding annotation errors with benchmark data, measuring dataset accuracy and completeness, designing validation workflows, and reporting quality findings to support more reliable AI pipelines.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals advancing from data annotation into quality assurance, dataset governance, and HITL operations roles.
modules: Foundations of Human-in-the-Loop AI and Data Quality
Error Identification and Benchmark Data Validation
Measuring Dataset Quality with Metrics and KPIs
Leading Annotator Teams for Productivity and Accuracy
Advanced QA for Generative AI and NLP Pipelines
Integration, Strategy, and Future of HITL Operations
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Completion of Course 1: Essentials of Data Labelling & Annotation for AI Development is required. Participants must have a working understanding of basic data annotation concepts and tools. No coding or programming experience is required for this intermediate-level course.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
